method_rationale: A revenue-multiple method remains appropriate because Xometry is growing rapidly and generating positive adjusted EBITDA, but GAAP earnings remain negative and stock-based compensation is material. The model applies scenario-specific enterprise-value-to-forward-revenue multiples to explicit 2027 revenue assumptions, adds scenario net cash, and divides by diluted-share assumptions. This prevents cash from being mistaken for operating value and recognizes dilution from the June equity issuance, stock awards and potentially dilutive securities.
bear_assumptions: Assume approximately USD1.00 billion of 2027 revenue, a 3.0x enterprise-value-to-revenue multiple, USD0.10 billion of remaining net cash and 66 million diluted shares. Arithmetic: (USD1.00 billion x 3.0 + USD0.10 billion) / 66 million = approximately USD47 per share. This case reflects growth slowing sharply from the issuer's 2026 outlook, continued marketplace gross-margin pressure, weaker cash conversion and further dilution.
base_assumptions: Assume approximately USD1.10 billion of 2027 revenue, a 4.5x enterprise-value-to-revenue multiple, USD0.188 billion of net cash and 65 million diluted shares. Arithmetic: (USD1.10 billion x 4.5 + USD0.188 billion) / 65 million = approximately USD79 per share. This case assumes growth moderates after 2026, marketplace gross margin stabilizes, operating leverage continues and GAAP profitability remains limited.
bull_assumptions: Assume approximately USD1.20 billion of 2027 revenue, a 6.0x enterprise-value-to-revenue multiple, USD0.25 billion of net cash and 64 million diluted shares. Arithmetic: (USD1.20 billion x 6.0 + USD0.25 billion) / 64 million = approximately USD116 per share. This requires sustained marketplace growth, improved pricing and routing economics, durable cash generation and contained dilution.
thesis: Xometry's two-sided custom-manufacturing marketplace is gaining buyers and larger accounts while producing substantial operating leverage, but the supplied USD88.94 market price already exceeds the USD79 base value and USD80.25 probability-weighted value. The operating evidence supports continued monitoring rather than a stronger valuation conclusion: marketplace revenue grew 45% in Q2 2026 and first-half operating cash flow turned positive, while GAAP losses, stock compensation, dilution and a 70-basis-point year-over-year decline in quarterly marketplace gross margin remain material counterevidence.
key_assumptions: The valuation assumes 2027 revenue of USD1.00 billion, USD1.10 billion and USD1.20 billion across the ordered scenarios; enterprise-value-to-revenue multiples of 3.0x, 4.5x and 6.0x; net cash of USD0.10 billion, USD0.188 billion and USD0.25 billion; and diluted shares of 66 million, 65 million and 64 million. The 25%/50%/25% probabilities emphasize the base case because reported buyer growth and raised guidance support continued expansion, while equal tail weights recognize both demonstrated operating leverage and meaningful margin, dilution and execution risks.
downside: The bear value is approximately 47% below the supplied market price. Marketplace gross margin fell to 34.7% from 35.4% year over year in Q2 even as marketplace revenue accelerated, showing that rapid volume growth does not automatically produce better unit economics. First-half stock-based compensation was USD19.7 million against USD17.5 million of operating cash flow, and the June equity transactions increased outstanding shares and supplied most of the balance-sheet expansion. Manufacturing demand is cyclical, buyer and supplier multi-homing can constrain network effects, international adjusted EBITDA remained negative, and adjusted EBITDA excludes recurring economic costs including equity compensation.
catalysts: Potential catalysts are delivery of the issuer's Q3 and full-year 2026 guidance; marketplace revenue continuing to outgrow consolidated revenue; stabilization or expansion of marketplace gross margin; sustained positive operating cash flow after capitalized software and equipment spending; growth in accounts spending at least USD50,000; and evidence that process recommendation, cost prediction and adaptive sourcing improve conversion, fulfillment reliability or contribution economics rather than merely increasing activity.
invalidation_conditions: The constructive operating thesis would be invalidated by marketplace growth falling below consolidated growth for two consecutive quarters, material stagnation in active buyers or larger accounts, persistent marketplace gross-margin contraction, renewed negative operating cash flow, or dilution growing faster than the modeled share counts. The base valuation would also be invalidated if 2027 revenue expectations fall materially below USD1.10 billion, if evidence no longer supports a 4.5x revenue multiple, or if net liquidity is consumed without corresponding durable growth or margin improvement.
limitations: Only one accessible current primary document could be cited in this operation: an issuer-authored earnings release filed as Exhibit 99.1 and mirrored by Yahoo's SEC filing archive. Direct SEC and investor-relations leads returned HTTP errors, while the attempted annual-filing mirror was too large for the bounded reader, so this refresh could not independently reopen the full risk-factor, debt-note and equity-footnote text. The release nevertheless includes operating statements, balance sheets, cash flows, share counts, guidance and non-GAAP reconciliations. The revenue multiples are analytical assumptions rather than issuer facts and were not triangulated against a current peer set. No Q3 2026 actual results were available in the opened evidence. The supplied market price is a context snapshot rather than a cited valuation input source. These limitations keep confidence at medium despite sufficient evidence for scenario valuation.

method_rationale: The valuation applies explicit earnings multiples to Yahoo Finance's USD 4.42 trailing GAAP EPS for Vertiv Class A common stock. Bear value is USD 4.42 times 25, or USD 110.50. Base value is USD 4.42 times 1.20 assumed earnings growth times 32, or USD 169.73. Bull value is USD 4.42 times 1.40 assumed growth times 38, or USD 235.14. At 25%/50%/25% probabilities, probability-weighted fair value is USD 171.28 per share. This method avoids carrying forward prior adjusted guidance that could not be reverified from an accessible primary filing, but comparability is limited because trailing GAAP EPS may contain items that do not represent normalized earnings.
bear_assumptions: Trailing GAAP EPS remains near USD 4.42 and the multiple contracts to 25x as hyperscaler financing concerns, project timing, cyclicality, competition, or weaker cash conversion temper expectations. No earnings growth is assumed.
base_assumptions: Trailing GAAP EPS grows 20% to USD 5.3048 over the horizon and the shares receive a 32x multiple. This assumes continued AI-data-center infrastructure demand, profitable execution and cash generation, but materially less exuberant valuation than the current trailing multiple.
bull_assumptions: Trailing GAAP EPS grows 40% to USD 6.188 and the market sustains a 38x multiple as power, thermal-management and liquid-cooling demand converts rapidly, margins remain strong and execution avoids material disruption.
thesis: Vertiv has economically attractive exposure to critical power and cooling infrastructure: the accessible evidence reports USD 11.48 billion of trailing revenue, USD 1.73 billion of trailing net income, a 15.09% profit margin and USD 2.7 billion of trailing levered free cash flow. Those figures support profitable growth and cash conversion, but the USD 194.32 reference price is about 44x trailing GAAP EPS and exceeds the USD 171.28 probability-weighted scenario value. The operating thesis remains plausible while the valuation thesis is only balanced, not strongly corroborated.
key_assumptions: The framework assumes the reported USD 4.42 trailing GAAP EPS is a usable starting point; 0%, 20% and 40% earnings growth in the bear, base and bull cases; terminal multiples of 25x, 32x and 38x; no material share-class mismatch; and no acquisition, divestiture, dilution or exceptional item large enough to invalidate per-share comparability. The growth rates and multiples are analyst assumptions rather than company guidance.
downside: The main downside is simultaneous earnings-expectation and multiple compression. The accessible quote reports a 52-week range of USD 147.82 to USD 379.93 and a five-year monthly beta of 2.05, demonstrating substantial equity volatility. Operating risks include hyperscaler capital-spending or financing pressure, project delays, customer concentration, fixed-price execution, supply constraints, competition and a failure of reported earnings to convert into durable free cash flow. Balance-sheet risk is assessed separately and is not deducted again here.
catalysts: The next reported earnings event was listed for 2026-10-28. Potential catalysts include evidence that AI-data-center power and thermal demand continues to convert into revenue, sustained or improving profitability, strong cash conversion, liquid-cooling adoption and guidance that validates growth above the base-case assumption. Because these outcomes had not occurred by the assessment timestamp, they remain prospective rather than verified facts.
invalidation_conditions: The thesis would be invalidated if revenue and earnings growth fail to justify a premium multiple, profitability or cash conversion deteriorates persistently, AI-infrastructure projects are materially deferred or cancelled, competitive offerings erode Vertiv's economics, or subsequent primary statements show that the secondary financial aggregates used here are materially incomplete or non-comparable. The valuation should also be rebuilt if share count, capital structure or reported EPS changes materially.
limitations: The supplied Q2 2026 SEC Form 10-Q and furnished results release were reopened first but returned HTTP errors, so neither is cited or treated as currently validated evidence. The assessment relies on one accessible Yahoo Finance page, which is a secondary financial-data aggregator rather than an issuer filing. It identifies VRT as Vertiv Holdings Co on the NYSE in USD and provides the current quote and financial aggregates, but it does not expose sufficient statement detail here to reconcile GAAP-to-adjusted earnings, working capital, debt maturities, backlog, segment performance or diluted share-count changes. Scenario growth and multiples are explicit assumptions, not company forecasts. These evidence limitations reduce confidence to low and require review after accessible primary results become available.

method_rationale: A scenario EV/revenue method is used because Parrot has only recently reached approximately break-even underlying operations, making an earnings multiple premature. H1 2026 revenue was EUR 57.3 million and management expected further Q3 growth, but warned that H2 comparisons, procurement timing, working capital and cash use would be challenging. Bear/base/bull enterprise values are EUR 131.25 million, EUR 240.00 million and EUR 405.00 million, based respectively on EUR 105 million at 1.25x, EUR 120 million at 2.00x and EUR 135 million at 3.00x revenue. Scenario net-cash adjustments of EUR 0 million, EUR 6.8 million and EUR 12 million reflect different H2 cash-use outcomes. Dividing by 31.157845 million shares produces EUR 4.21, EUR 7.92 and EUR 13.38 per share. The multiples are judgmental rather than peer-derived, which limits precision.
bear_assumptions: EUR 105 million revenue at 1.25x EV/revenue, no residual net-cash credit and 31.157845 million shares. This case assumes irregular institutional orders, a weak fourth quarter against a higher comparison base, margin pressure as ANAFI UKR scales, and substantial working-capital absorption.
base_assumptions: EUR 120 million revenue at 2.00x EV/revenue, EUR 6.8 million net cash and 31.157845 million shares. The net-cash adjustment starts from June 30 cash of EUR 18.8 million and deducts EUR 5.0 million of partner funding, EUR 6.5 million of lease liabilities and EUR 0.5 million of financial liabilities. The case assumes continued but moderating micro-UAV growth, approximately break-even underlying operations and manageable H2 cash use.
bull_assumptions: EUR 135 million revenue at 3.00x EV/revenue, EUR 12 million net cash and 31.157845 million shares. This requires strong follow-on ANAFI UKR deliveries, additional institutional wins, improving product maturity and mix, successful subscription execution at PIX4D, and limited cash absorption or dilution.
thesis: Parrot has become a directly evidenced beneficiary of sovereign professional-drone procurement: H1 micro-UAV revenue increased 134%, the segment generated positive current operating income, and deliveries were diversified across several allied countries. The counterweight is that underlying group operations were only around break-even after excluding insurance proceeds, institutional tenders are irregular, and management expects greater H2 working-capital use. Probability-weighted value of EUR 7.90 is only modestly above the supplied EUR 7.54 reference price, so the evidence supports the operating thesis more strongly than it supports a large valuation discount.
key_assumptions: The valuation assumes one ordinary-share class and 31.157845 million shares, H1 momentum translating into EUR 105 million to EUR 135 million of annual revenue, no material unreported capital change after September 30, and scenario-dependent net cash of EUR 0 million to EUR 12 million. It also assumes that the H1 insurance benefit does not recur, ANAFI UKR demand remains material but lumpy, and PIX4D's subscription transition does not cause a prolonged deterioration.
downside: The bear case implies material downside if defense deliveries slip, follow-on orders fail to replace initial tenders, ANAFI UKR margins remain below mature-product levels, or inventory and receivables absorb cash. Customer procurement schedules are outside Parrot's control. Product and program concentration, rapid technical change, manufacturing execution, foreign-exchange exposure and potential dilution add residual risk. Financing capacity is considered separately in the balance-sheet score rather than deducted again from the risk score.
catalysts: Catalysts include conversion of awarded contracts into repeat ANAFI UKR deliveries, new institutional tenders, improved unit economics as production matures, commercialization of CHUCK 3.0, growth in PIX4D subscriptions and evidence that H2 working-capital use remains controlled. The scheduled October 28, 2026 Q3 business and revenue release is the nearest identified financial catalyst.
invalidation_conditions: The positive operating thesis would be invalidated by sustained contraction in micro-UAV revenue, failure of awards to generate repeat deliveries, underlying operating losses after removing non-recurring benefits, worsening cash conversion without a clear temporary working-capital explanation, or financing that materially dilutes per-share value. The valuation would also require revision if Q3 results materially differ from the revenue range or if the reported share count changes.
limitations: The latest opened financial results cover only the six months ended June 30, 2026; the scheduled Q3 release was still four days away at the assessment date. Revenue multiples are scenario judgments without a current peer-comparison source, and the H2 cash adjustments are assumptions rather than company guidance. The supplied EUR 7.54 market observation is from yfinance rather than an opened exchange page, although its PARRO.PA symbol, EUR currency and October 23 latest completed session reconcile with the issuer's one-class Euronext Paris identity. No independent order-book value, customer-concentration table or audited H2 data was available in the opened evidence.

method_rationale: A scenario adjusted-EPS method is more suitable than capitalizing the unusually strong Q2 result or treating the market price as fair value. Evonik supplies 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance, depreciation, financial-result and tax indications, while its 466 million-share count is verified. Estimated adjusted EPS is calculated as ((adjusted EBITDA minus adjusted D&A minus adjusted net financial expense) multiplied by one minus the adjusted tax rate, minus adjusted non-controlling interests) divided by 466 million shares. Scenario P/E multiples then reflect Evonik’s specialty-chemical assets, cyclicality, leverage, restructuring burden and the temporary nature of part of Q2 earnings.
bear_assumptions: Adjusted EBITDA falls to €1.80 billion after temporary supply-chain benefits reverse; adjusted D&A is €1.00 billion, adjusted net financial expense is €162 million, tax is 25%, adjusted non-controlling interests are €12 million and shares are 466 million. This produces approximately €1.00 adjusted EPS, valued at 10x because of cyclical weakness, execution risk and leverage.
base_assumptions: Adjusted EBITDA is €2.00 billion, the bottom of current 2026 guidance and a cautious normalized run rate; adjusted D&A is €980 million, adjusted net financial expense is €162 million, tax is 25%, adjusted non-controlling interests are €12 million and shares are 466 million. The resulting approximately €1.36 adjusted EPS is valued at 14x, balancing specialty-product quality and efficiency gains against cyclicality and balance-sheet constraints.
bull_assumptions: Adjusted EBITDA reaches €2.20 billion, the top of current guidance, with durable Animal Nutrition pricing, stronger utilization and successful efficiency measures; adjusted D&A is €950 million, adjusted net financial expense is €162 million, tax is 25%, adjusted non-controlling interests are €12 million and shares are 466 million. Approximately €1.73 adjusted EPS receives a 16x multiple as earnings quality and balance-sheet confidence improve.
thesis: Evonik combines differentiated additives, care, health-care, silica, polymers and animal-nutrition businesses, but near-term earnings quality is mixed. Q2 adjusted EBITDA rose 24% to €630 million and management raised 2026 guidance to €2.0–€2.2 billion; however, management explicitly characterized part of the gain as an economic windfall from Middle East-related supply bottlenecks. The base valuation therefore uses the bottom of guidance rather than extrapolating Q2, and it indicates less value than the supplied €21.42 market close while retaining meaningful upside if high-end earnings and efficiency gains persist.
key_assumptions: The 466 million registered shares remain the appropriate denominator; adjusted EBITDA, D&A, financial-result and tax definitions remain comparable; restructuring and impairments are not permanently recurring at Q2 intensity; the temporary supply-chain benefit fades in bear and base cases; and no major acquisition, disposal or capital issuance changes per-share economics. The valuation also assumes that an earnings multiple captures financial leverage adequately, although €3.62 billion of net financial debt and €1.538 billion of pension provisions remain important constraints.
downside: The principal downside is normalization of methionine, crosslinker and C4 pricing once disrupted Asian supply returns, compounded by weak European chemical demand and unfavorable currency effects. Q2 included €207 million of adjustments, including restructuring and an Oxeno impairment; reported Q2 net income was only €84 million despite strong adjusted EBITDA. Net financial debt rose to €3.62 billion after the dividend, pension provisions were €1.538 billion, and Q2 free cash flow of €49 million remained modest relative to EBITDA.
catalysts: Potential catalysts are delivery near the upper end of €2.0–€2.2 billion adjusted EBITDA guidance, sustained Animal Nutrition pricing, improved utilization in Organics, benefits from methionine backward integration, realization of the extended Evonik Tailor Made savings program, stronger cash conversion and demonstrable debt reduction. The scheduled Q3 2026 report can test whether Q2’s pricing and volume gains persisted beyond the initial disruption.
invalidation_conditions: The constructive scenarios would be invalidated by adjusted EBITDA tracking below €1.8 billion, persistent cash conversion materially below management’s approximately 40% target, net financial debt rising without a corresponding earnings increase, recurring adjustments that prevent adjusted earnings from translating into reported profit, or evidence that Q2 pricing gains reverse faster than assumed. The bear case would become too pessimistic if upper-guidance earnings persist after supply chains normalize and debt declines materially.
limitations: Only Q2/H1 2026 and prior-year issuer data were available because Q3 reporting was scheduled after the assessment date. The encrypted quarterly-statement PDF could not be used, so the valuation relies on accessible issuer fact sheets, detailed financial tables and releases. Scenario multiples are analyst assumptions rather than company guidance or observed peer multiples. No independently verified 2027 consensus, pension cash-payment schedule or segment-level normalized-cycle forecast was used. The issuer verifies EVK registered shares and Xetra-related identifiers, but the exact MIC string XETR and Yahoo provider symbol EVK.DE are not stated on the issuer page; identity IDs were therefore retained without alteration.

method_rationale: Normalized earnings remains preferable to current-period EPS or adjusted EBITDA because MP Materials is transitioning from concentrate production toward separated rare-earth products and magnets. Q2 contained material price-protection income, start-up expenses and a still-qualifying downstream operation, so reported quarterly results are not representative of mature common-equity earnings. Scenario values are explicit EPS-and-multiple assumptions rather than company guidance: USD 1.00 times 18, USD 2.00 times 20 and USD 3.00 times 24.
bear_assumptions: USD 1.00 normalized common EPS multiplied by 18 if rare-earth pricing or contractual support weakens, magnet qualification and 10X execution slip, customer concentration persists, or financing and dilution absorb operating progress.
base_assumptions: USD 2.00 normalized common EPS multiplied by 20 if separated-product volumes remain durable, Independence progresses from qualification toward commercial output, contracted economics persist and expansion is funded without severe incremental dilution.
bull_assumptions: USD 3.00 normalized common EPS multiplied by 24 if separated products and magnets scale successfully, protected economics convert into recurring cash generation, customers diversify and capital intensity declines without material dilution.
thesis: MP Materials has credible vertical-integration progress: Q2 NdPr production increased 41% year over year to 840 metric tons, sales increased 127% to 1,006 metric tons and consolidated revenue reached USD 108.5 million. The equity case nevertheless depends on converting protected and start-up economics into durable common earnings. The supplied USD 40.17 close is approximately aligned with the USD 40 base value and below the USD 42.50 probability-weighted scenario value, materially improving valuation balance versus the prior review but not eliminating execution and financing risk.
key_assumptions: The central assumption is USD 2.00 of normalized common EPS at a 20-times multiple. This requires sustained separated-product output, successful magnet qualification and commercialization, continued contractual economics, manageable capital requirements and no severe dilution. Bear/base/bull probabilities are 25%/50%/25%, totaling 100%, because operating progress is tangible but the mature earnings level remains unverified.
downside: The bear case is USD 18 per share. Principal downside mechanisms are weaker rare-earth pricing, loss or reduction of price-protection economics, delayed magnet qualification, 10X construction or technology setbacks, customer concentration, operating disruption at Mountain Pass, persistent start-up costs, high funding requirements and dilution. Q2 GAAP net loss of USD 20.3 million despite USD 17.6 million of price-protection income demonstrates that positive adjusted EBITDA has not yet become durable common earnings.
catalysts: Potential catalysts include sustained NdPr production and sales, improved through-cycle unit economics, completion of Independence qualification, commercial magnet shipments, 10X construction milestones, heavy-rare-earth separation progress, conversion of offtake agreements into revenue and cash, and broader aerospace, defense, drone and industrial customer adoption.
invalidation_conditions: The thesis would be invalidated by persistent NdPr production or cost underperformance, failed or materially delayed magnet qualification, major 10X delays, loss or adverse revision of contractual support, liquidity deterioration without corresponding operating cash generation, or dilution that prevents operating growth from increasing normalized per-share earnings. Conversely, repeatable positive common earnings and free cash flow above the base assumptions would invalidate the cautious normalization.
limitations: The latest completed operating period available in opened primary evidence is Q2 2026; Q3 results were not available in the opened issuer materials. The SEC-hosted Q2 filing URL and SEC submissions feed returned access errors through the research interface, so detailed balance-sheet figures from the prior review were not carried into the refreshed factual case. The issuer's filing index was opened but is dynamically rendered and exposed no filing rows. Normalized EPS is an analyst assumption rather than company guidance, and commodity prices, contractual support, construction timing, financing needs and future share count remain uncertain. The supplied market snapshot is current to 2026-10-16, but it is contextual market data rather than primary issuer evidence.

method_rationale: A 12-month earnings multiple is appropriate because the opened market source provides trailing per-ADR EPS and current quarterly results but not enough primary-source detail for a full discounted-cash-flow model. Bear, base and bull values equal USD12.50 at 20x, USD15.50 at 28x and USD18.00 at 33x, respectively. The 25%/50%/25% probabilities center the analysis on current trailing earnings while allowing for both an AI-demand correction and continued leading-node growth. The probability-weighted fair value is USD428 per ADR.
bear_assumptions: Per-ADR earnings normalize to USD12.50 and the multiple contracts to 20x. This case assumes an AI-capacity digestion period, weaker utilization or pricing, overseas-factory margin dilution and a higher risk premium for geographic and customer concentration.
base_assumptions: Per-ADR earnings approximate USD15.50, close to the USD15.43 trailing figure reported by Yahoo Finance, and receive a 28x multiple. AI and high-performance-computing demand remains healthy, but growth moderates and costs from 2-nanometer and overseas expansion restrain incremental margins.
bull_assumptions: Per-ADR earnings reach USD18.00 and receive a 33x multiple as leading-node and advanced-packaging demand remains supply constrained, the 2-nanometer ramp succeeds and overseas investment does not materially impair consolidated profitability.
thesis: TSMC's foundry leadership and exposure to AI computing remain strongly supported by record August revenue and Yahoo Finance's reported record third-quarter earnings. The economic thesis depends on process leadership, manufacturing scale and customer trust translating sustained advanced-chip demand into high margins and cash conversion. At USD418.51, the probability-weighted USD428 valuation indicates only modest value support rather than a wide margin of safety.
key_assumptions: The analysis assumes the Yahoo Finance trailing EPS of USD15.43 belongs to the NYSE-listed TSM ADR in USD; normalized 12-month ADR earnings span USD12.50 to USD18.00; AI and high-performance-computing demand remains the principal growth driver; 2-nanometer and overseas capacity costs are manageable in the base case; and the current capital structure remains resilient. Scenario probabilities total 100% and represent valuation uncertainty rather than probabilities of investment profit.

method_rationale: The valuation applies scenario-specific earnings multiples to normalized annual preferred-share EPS, converts one preferred GDR at the verified ratio of 25 underlying non-voting preferred shares, and translates KRW into EUR. The arithmetic is: normalized EPS × P/E × 25 ÷ scenario KRW per EUR. This method reflects Samsung's cyclical semiconductor economics without capitalizing the exceptional Q2 2026 quarter as a permanent run rate. Historical issuer figures show annual profit ranging from KRW 15.5 trillion in 2023 to KRW 55.7 trillion in 2022, while Q2 2026 preferred EPS was KRW 10,849 for one quarter. The resulting normalization is explicitly an analyst assumption rather than issuer guidance. The instrument bridge is now supportable because the prospectus and depositary record both establish the 25:1 ratio and ISIN US7960502018, the Vienna exchange identifies that same ISIN as SSUN in EUR, and the ECB supplies the KRW/EUR reference rate.
bear_assumptions: Normalized preferred-share EPS of KRW 7,500, an 8× P/E and KRW 1,550 per EUR imply KRW 60,000 per underlying preferred share and KRW 1,500,000 per 25-share GDR; translation gives approximately EUR 968, rounded to EUR 970. This assumes memory profitability normalizes sharply, non-memory losses persist and valuation compression accompanies the downturn.
base_assumptions: Normalized preferred-share EPS of KRW 12,000, a 10× P/E and KRW 1,500 per EUR imply KRW 120,000 per underlying preferred share and KRW 3,000,000 per 25-share GDR, equal to EUR 2,000. This assumes AI-server memory remains structurally stronger than the last trough but Q2 2026 profitability is not sustained at its exceptional quarterly pace.
bull_assumptions: Normalized preferred-share EPS of KRW 18,000, a 12× P/E and KRW 1,450 per EUR imply KRW 216,000 per underlying preferred share and KRW 5,400,000 per 25-share GDR; translation gives approximately EUR 3,724, rounded to EUR 3,720. This requires durable HBM4 and server-memory scarcity, stronger foundry utilization, recovery in device profitability and a firmer won.
thesis: Samsung's preferred GDR provides 25-share exposure to a diversified technology issuer whose Q2 2026 earnings were dominated by exceptional AI-led memory profitability. The operating outlook is favorable if HBM4, server DRAM and enterprise SSD demand remain supply constrained, but the EUR 2,740 Vienna reference price exceeds the EUR 2,000 base fair value and already discounts a substantial portion of the bull case. The valuation therefore separates a constructive issuer thesis from an instrument whose sparse Vienna price formation, currency exposure and cross-venue basis materially reduce confidence.
key_assumptions: The Vienna security with ticker SSUN and ISIN US7960502018 is treated as the same preferred GDR described by the prospectus and Citi, with each GDR representing 25 Samsung non-voting preferred shares. Scenario EPS is normalized rather than annualizing Q2 2026 EPS of KRW 10,849. Preferred and common EPS remain economically close apart from the preferred distribution entitlement. Multiples of 8×, 10× and 12× reflect semiconductor cyclicality, Samsung's diversification and balance-sheet resilience. Scenario FX rates bracket the ECB reference of KRW 1,499.01 per EUR. The Vienna trading currency is EUR even though the prospectus describes the GDR as USD-denominated. No same-time arbitrage closure between Korea, London and Vienna is assumed.
downside: The main downside is that current memory pricing and margins prove cyclical rather than structural. The prospectus identifies semiconductor and display cyclicality, secular selling-price pressure, competition, complex manufacturing and supplier dependence as material risks. Q2 2026 also showed losses in mobile/network and consumer-device groupings despite record semiconductor profit. Foundry execution, export restrictions, customer qualification, capital intensity, won weakness and depositary fees can reduce per-GDR value. Vienna's displayed EUR 2,740 price had no bid or ask and the exchange explains that a displayed price can exist without turnover, so observable price may not represent executable fair value.
catalysts: Potential catalysts are sustained HBM4 and server-memory shipments, successful HBM4E customer qualification, continued DRAM and enterprise-SSD supply tightness, advanced-node foundry design wins, recovery in mobile and consumer-device margins, persistent cash conversion, and a narrowing of the preferred-GDR basis across Korea, London and Vienna. Stronger normalized earnings or a firmer won would increase the EUR valuation directly.
invalidation_conditions: The positive operating thesis would be invalidated by a structural reversal in server-memory demand or pricing, repeated HBM qualification losses, deterioration in advanced-node execution, persistent non-memory losses that offset semiconductor gains, materially weaker cash generation, or balance-sheet deterioration. The scenario valuation should be rebuilt if the 25:1 depositary ratio changes, if ISIN US7960502018 no longer represents the maintained Vienna instrument, or if reported preferred-share EPS cannot be reconciled with the issuer's capital structure. The base case would also fail if normalized EPS settles materially below KRW 12,000 or if the market warrants a sustained multiple below 10×.
limitations: The latest detailed operating release inspected in this operation was Q2 2026. Samsung's current earnings index displays a Q3 2026 entry, but its detailed contents were not opened and are not incorporated. Scenario EPS, P/E multiples and FX rates are assumptions, not company guidance. The historical prospectus supplies consolidated profit rather than a complete through-cycle series of preferred EPS. Primary sources conflict on the London ticker: Samsung's listing page says SMSEL, while the 2025 prospectus and Citi identify SMSD LI; the ISIN, preferred class and 25:1 ratio are consistent, so immutable IDs were retained. The Vienna page verifies SSUN and EUR price data but does not provide routine liquidity sufficient to establish reliable price discovery. Depositary fees, taxes, preferred/common basis and timing differences are not modeled separately.

Consequently, the Q2 inputs and prior USD 400/USD 600/USD 800 scenarios cannot be treated as current or independently verified.
thesis: The prior thesis—that Meta's advertising and engagement advantages can fund AI investment and additional messaging monetization—remains a hypothesis rather than a current supported conclusion. The accessible October 2026 filing records establish the issuer, Class A security, ticker, exchange, and existence of a newer quarterly filing, but they do not expose the latest operating results needed to test growth, margins, cash conversion, dilution, or AI-capital productivity.
key_assumptions: A supportable valuation would need the October 2026 Form 10-Q's latest revenue growth, segment profitability, operating margin, capital expenditures, operating and free cash flow, stock compensation, diluted share count, cash, marketable securities, debt, guidance, and material risk disclosures. None of those current-period values could be verified from the accessible filing index and cover information, so no numerical assumptions or scenarios are retained.
downside: Material downside mechanisms identified in the prior research include weaker advertising demand or pricing, engagement deterioration, margin pressure, unproductive AI infrastructure spending, persistent Reality Labs losses, dilution, governance concentration, and adverse privacy, youth-safety, competition, or platform regulation. Their current severity cannot be measured without the latest quarterly financial statements and risk disclosures. Financing risk is intentionally reserved for the balance-sheet factor rather than counted again in the residual risk assessment.
catalysts: Potential catalysts remain improved advertising monetization, demonstrated returns from recommendation and AI infrastructure spending, profitable messaging or Threads monetization, stronger per-share cash conversion, disciplined Reality Labs spending, and favorable legal or regulatory developments. The accessible October filing records do not verify that any of these catalysts occurred, so they are monitoring hypotheses rather than incorporated valuation drivers.
invalidation_conditions: The investment hypothesis would be weakened or invalidated by sustained deterioration in users, engagement, ad impressions or pricing; Family of Apps margin erosion without commensurate durable growth; capital spending that persistently suppresses per-share cash generation; material dilution; escalating Reality Labs losses; or legal and regulatory outcomes that structurally impair targeting, distribution, or monetization. Current evidence is insufficient to determine whether any threshold has been crossed.
limitations: A newer October 22, 2026 Form 10-Q exists and supersedes the Q2 filing underlying the prior assessment, but its financial content could not be read through the research broker. The accessible October 21 Form 8-K cover information verifies Meta Platforms, Inc., Class A common stock, ticker META, and Nasdaq registration, but not current operating performance or valuation inputs. The supplied USD 642.6199951171875 October 23 market observation is current and denominated in USD, yet no fair-value scenarios can be supported, so it is not used to calculate a valuation score. No secondary reporting was substituted for the missing primary financial statements.

method_rationale: A 12-month earnings-multiple method is appropriate because the accessible issuer release supplies 2026 adjusted-EPS guidance of USD7.20-USD7.40, while Fiserv's recurring processing and merchant-service economics make per-share earnings a more usable valuation anchor than the quarter's transformation-affected GAAP earnings. Bear value is USD7.20 multiplied by 5.0x, or USD36.00; base value is the USD7.30 guidance midpoint multiplied by 9.0x, or USD65.70; and bull value is USD7.40 multiplied by 13.0x, or USD96.20. Probabilities of 30%/50%/20% produce USD62.89 probability-weighted value. The wide multiples reflect substantial uncertainty after second-quarter organic contraction, margin compression and reduced guidance. [[source_web_9d75fa93bca1e34a2519d88e]]
bear_assumptions: Adjusted EPS finishes at the USD7.20 low end and receives a 5.0x multiple because organic contraction, client or service execution problems and transformation costs remain persistent. The unusually low multiple also reflects unresolved leverage and cash-conversion uncertainty.
base_assumptions: Adjusted EPS reaches the USD7.30 midpoint of management's USD7.20-USD7.40 range and receives a 9.0x multiple. The scenario assumes 2026 remains a reset year, recurring processing revenue proves durable, execution stabilizes and margins stop deteriorating without yet returning to historical levels.
bull_assumptions: Adjusted EPS reaches USD7.40 and receives a 13.0x multiple as merchant and financial-institution volumes translate into renewed organic growth, execution improvements become visible, margins begin recovering and free-cash-flow confidence improves.
thesis: Fiserv retains recurring exposure to payment, merchant-acquiring, account-processing, digital-banking, network, e-commerce and Clover activity, but the near-term investment case is a recovery thesis rather than an established compounder thesis. The issuer reported second-quarter adjusted revenue down 4%, organic revenue down 5%, adjusted EPS down 26% and adjusted operating margin down materially, while reducing 2026 expectations to negative 1% to flat organic growth and USD7.20-USD7.40 adjusted EPS. Durable recurring revenue and continued transaction and account activity may support recovery, but current operating evidence is adverse. [[source_web_9d75fa93bca1e34a2519d88e]]
key_assumptions: The central assumptions are that management's USD7.20-USD7.40 adjusted-EPS guidance remains achievable; recurring processing relationships prevent a prolonged revenue decline; transformation spending eventually improves service and execution; first-half free cash flow of USD1.36 billion remains meaningfully positive; and refinancing and capital returns do not impair financial flexibility. These are assumptions, not verified recovery outcomes. [[source_web_9d75fa93bca1e34a2519d88e]]
downside: The principal downside is that second-quarter weakness is structural rather than temporary. Financial Solutions organic revenue fell 8%, consolidated adjusted operating margin contracted, first-half free cash flow declined from USD1.54 billion to USD1.36 billion, and management reduced its outlook. Continued client losses, pricing pressure, weak Clover execution, service disruption, elevated transformation costs or constrained capital deployment could push earnings below guidance or justify a multiple below the base case. The bear case values USD7.20 of adjusted EPS at 5.0x, or USD36.00 per share. [[source_web_9d75fa93bca1e34a2519d88e]]
catalysts: Potential catalysts are subsequent results showing sequential improvement in organic revenue, stabilization of Financial Solutions, renewed Merchant Solutions growth, better adjusted operating margins and stronger free-cash-flow conversion. Evidence that the One Fiserv program is improving technology and client service without continuing exceptional costs would support a higher multiple. Completion and financial clarification of the MoneyPass Group transaction, plus disciplined debt reduction or repurchases funded by sustainable cash generation, could also improve confidence. [[source_web_9d75fa93bca1e34a2519d88e]]
invalidation_conditions: The recovery thesis is invalidated if adjusted EPS falls below the USD7.20 guidance floor without a clearly temporary cause; organic revenue remains negative beyond the stated 2026 reset; Financial Solutions contraction or client attrition persists; margins and free cash flow fail to stabilize; transformation expenses become recurring; or debt service materially restricts investment and capital flexibility. Conversely, the low-multiple framework should be reconsidered upward if reported organic growth, margins and cash conversion recover substantially faster than assumed. [[source_web_9d75fa93bca1e34a2519d88e]]
limitations: Only one accessible current primary financial release could be used. The supplied SEC Form 10-Q URL returned HTTP 403 in this operation, so detailed balance-sheet debt, cash, share-count, contractual and footnote information was not independently examined or carried forward. The issuer release relies heavily on non-GAAP measures, notes that such measures may not be comparable across companies and does not reconcile forward guidance because excluded items are variable. Scenario multiples are analyst assumptions rather than issuer forecasts or observed peer multiples, and the method does not explicitly adjust for net debt. The assessment should therefore be refreshed after the next financial report or any material guidance, client, margin, cash-flow or financing update. [[source_web_9d75fa93bca1e34a2519d88e]]

method_rationale: A forward earnings multiple is more supportable than a detailed discounted-cash-flow model with the available evidence. Xylem provided 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $5.55-$5.70 and a free-cash-flow-margin outlook of 10.2%-11.0%, but not enough long-range cash-flow detail to justify a granular DCF. The scenarios therefore estimate 2027 adjusted EPS and apply different multiples reflecting growth, margin execution, durability, and project risk. Fair value arithmetic is EPS multiplied by the scenario multiple: bear $5.40 x 16 = $86.40; base $6.10 x 21 = $128.10; bull $6.60 x 25 = $165.00. Probabilities of 25%, 50%, and 25% give a probability-weighted value of $126.90 per share.
bear_assumptions: 2027 adjusted EPS is $5.40, below the midpoint of 2026 guidance, as low organic revenue growth persists, the large Water Solutions and Services order intake converts slowly, customer projects are delayed, and pricing or productivity no longer fully offsets inflation and volume pressure. A 16x multiple reflects weaker execution and greater cyclicality.
base_assumptions: 2027 adjusted EPS reaches $6.10 as the 2026 guidance midpoint provides the earnings base, modest organic growth and backlog conversion support revenue, and margins broadly retain the productivity and mix benefits evident in the second quarter. A 21x multiple recognizes durable water-infrastructure demand while allowing for modest current organic growth and execution risk.
bull_assumptions: 2027 adjusted EPS reaches $6.60 as strong orders convert efficiently, industrial and municipal water demand broadens, and adjusted EBITDA margins remain around or above the 2026 outlook. A 25x multiple assumes investors continue to value Xylem as a durable, high-quality water technology compounder.
thesis: Xylem combines a resilient municipal-water foundation with industrial, measurement, treatment, pumping, and service exposure. Second-quarter revenue grew only 1% organically, but adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 23.3%, adjusted EPS increased 16%, and management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance. Orders rose 41% organically, although most of the increase came from Water Solutions and Services, so conversion timing and concentration require caution. The investment case is supported by margin execution, broad water-system exposure, and management's reported strengthening demand drivers, but not by rapid current organic revenue growth.
key_assumptions: The valuation assumes the issuer's $5.55-$5.70 adjusted EPS guidance is a reasonable 2026 earnings base; restructuring, amortization, divestiture, and tariff-related adjustments do not mask a persistent deterioration in economics; the order increase converts into profitable revenue rather than cancellation or prolonged backlog; productivity and pricing continue to offset inflation; and approximately 236 million diluted shares remains a reasonable per-share denominator. The 2027 EPS estimates and valuation multiples are analyst assumptions rather than company guidance.
downside: Material downside could arise if utility or industrial budgets weaken, large projects are delayed or misexecuted, the concentrated Water Solutions and Services order increase does not convert, or Measurement and Control Solutions remains soft. Other risks include inflation, tariffs, supply constraints, cybersecurity, product or project liabilities, regulation, foreign exchange, acquisition integration, and impairment of substantial goodwill and acquired intangibles. At June 30, 2026, debt exceeded cash and had increased after debt issuance and sizable share repurchases, reducing balance-sheet flexibility relative to a net-cash company.
catalysts: Potential catalysts include conversion of the $3.1 billion second-quarter order intake into revenue, continued adjusted-margin expansion, delivery of the raised 2026 adjusted EPS range, stronger Measurement and Control Solutions revenue, sustained industrial demand related to semiconductors, power, mining, food and beverage, and life sciences, and free-cash-flow improvement toward the full-year margin outlook.
invalidation_conditions: The thesis would be invalidated or require material revision if organic growth remains near zero while orders fail to convert, adjusted margins retreat despite claimed productivity benefits, free cash flow persistently falls short of guidance, debt-funded capital returns weaken financing resilience, or evidence shows that water-scarcity and industrial-demand themes are not translating into profitable company revenue. A sustained decline in municipal funding, loss of pricing power, major project losses, or material cyber, regulatory, or product-liability events would also invalidate key assumptions.
limitations: Only one newly opened primary source was usable for the assessment. It is detailed and includes financial statements, segment data, guidance, reconciliations, and risk disclosures, but it remains issuer-authored and unaudited quarterly material. A full current Form 10-Q and the 2025 Form 10-K were not successfully inspected in this operation, limiting independent review of footnotes, debt maturities, backlog quality, customer concentration, and contingencies. The extraordinary order growth was concentrated in Water Solutions and Services, and the source does not establish the timing or profitability of conversion. The supplied market observation verifies the mapped XYL security, XNYS venue, USD currency, and latest completed-session close, but no separately opened exchange quote was available. Scenario EPS, multiples, and probabilities are judgmental rather than company forecasts.

method_rationale: A 12-month earnings-multiple valuation is appropriate because Schneider is a profitable, diversified industrial compounder with disclosed adjusted EPS, margins and organic-growth guidance. H1 adjusted EPS was EUR 4.79 and management targeted 10-13% organic revenue growth with 70-100 basis points of organic adjusted-EBITA margin improvement for 2026. The scenarios apply explicit multiples to normalized forward adjusted EPS assumptions rather than treating management guidance as fair value. The bear, base and bull values are EUR 10.00 x 19, EUR 10.00 x 24 and EUR 10.65 x approximately 31, respectively; probabilities of 25%, 50% and 25% produce a EUR 250 probability-weighted value.
bear_assumptions: EUR 10.00 normalized forward adjusted EPS at 19x. Data-centre systems growth moderates, negative mix and input costs constrain margins, working-capital absorption persists, and acquisition funding limits multiple support. The 25% probability recognizes meaningful normalization and execution risk without assuming structural impairment.
base_assumptions: EUR 10.00 normalized forward adjusted EPS at 24x. Organic growth and operating leverage continue, but systems mix, working capital, integration spending and a still-demanding multiple offset part of the operational improvement. The 50% probability reflects this as the central outcome supported by current guidance and H1 execution.
bull_assumptions: EUR 10.65 normalized forward adjusted EPS at approximately 31x. Data-centre demand and backlog convert broadly, Energy Management sustains strong profitability, recurring software and services expand, and acquisitions preserve per-share returns. The 25% probability reflects the strong demand evidence but also the execution required to sustain a premium multiple.
thesis: Schneider combines electrical distribution, automation, cooling, UPS, prefabricated power, software and lifecycle services, giving it broad exposure to electrification and data-centre investment. FY2025 and H1 2026 results corroborate profitable growth: H1 revenue rose 14.0% organically, adjusted EBITA rose 22.1% organically, margin reached 19.3%, and free cash flow improved to EUR 1.631 billion. At the supplied EUR 231.40 reference, the EUR 250 weighted fair value indicates modest valuation support, but the EUR 240 base case offers only limited headroom and the EUR 190 bear case remains material.
key_assumptions: Normalized forward adjusted EPS reaches about EUR 10.00 in the central case; management substantially delivers its 10-13% organic revenue-growth and 70-100 basis-point organic margin-improvement targets; data-centre demand converts without severe project delays; pricing and productivity offset tariffs and raw-material inflation; H2 cash conversion improves; recurring software growth persists; and Cognite, AiDASH and other capital allocation do not materially dilute per-share value.
downside: The bear value is EUR 190, about 18% below the supplied EUR 231.40 reference. Systems-led growth can create adverse mix, large data-centre customers may gain bargaining power, and connection or project delays can defer conversion. Trade working capital absorbed EUR 1.208 billion in H1, net debt reached EUR 15.360 billion, and pending acquisitions add funding and integration risk. Tariffs, inflation, supply-chain disruption, foreign exchange, Middle East disruption and a reversal in data-centre capital spending could reduce earnings and the valuation multiple.
catalysts: Potential catalysts include sustained data-centre demand and backlog conversion, delivery of upgraded 2026 revenue and margin guidance, stronger second-half cash conversion, positive net pricing, continued double-digit AVEVA recurring-revenue growth, greater service attachment to the installed base, and evidence that Cognite or AiDASH adds recurring growth and per-share returns without materially weakening financial resilience.
invalidation_conditions: The constructive thesis would be materially weakened by contraction in data-centre orders or backlog, recurring project delays, sustained adjusted-EBITA margin compression from systems mix, failure to improve second-half cash conversion, rising customer concentration, persistent working-capital deterioration, materially higher net debt, loss of A-grade ratings, or acquisition returns that fail to cover funding and integration costs. Fair values must also be revisited if normalized forward adjusted EPS cannot approach EUR 10.00 or if the market no longer supports the selected mature-compounder multiples.
limitations: The opened evidence is issuer-authored and therefore strong for reported financials but not independent corroboration. The releases do not separately quantify data-centre revenue, orders, backlog, customer concentration, project economics or returns on dedicated capacity. H1 is not a full-year cash-conversion test, acquisition completions and integration outcomes remain uncertain, and no Q3 2026 primary operating release was available in the opened evidence set. The supplied market observation verifies the security ID, SU.PA provider symbol, XPAR venue and EUR quote, but the issuer releases do not independently document the provider symbol. Scenario EPS and multiples are analytical assumptions rather than company guidance, and the narrow base-case premium to the reference price makes the conclusion sensitive to modest changes in earnings or multiples.

thesis: Tencent's large games, Weixin, advertising, payments and cloud ecosystem continues to produce broad-based revenue and gross-profit growth. AI-enhanced advertising and cloud demand offer credible operating upside, while accelerated compute procurement, negative quarterly free cash flow and declining net cash are material contrary evidence. The operating thesis is supported, but a security-level USD valuation is not supportable from the currently opened evidence.
key_assumptions: The operating thesis assumes domestic games and marketing retain momentum, Weixin engagement remains durable, AI recommendations continue improving advertising economics, cloud demand absorbs added compute capacity, and elevated infrastructure spending ultimately converts into revenue and cash flow. No assumption is made about the unverified TCEHY ADR conversion ratio.
downside: Capital expenditure reached RMB52.8 billion in the second quarter, free cash flow was negative RMB13.8 billion, and net cash declined to RMB58.2 billion. Poor utilization or monetization of AI infrastructure could depress cash conversion and returns. Additional risks include game cyclicality, platform regulation, competition, investee-value volatility and the evidentiary uncertainty associated with translating Hong Kong ordinary-share economics into an unsponsored US ADR.
catalysts: Potential catalysts are continued domestic-games and advertising growth, successful monetization of new AI products, higher cloud demand, recovery in free cash flow after compute prepayments normalize, and continued repurchases that improve ordinary-share per-share economics. invalidation_conditions: The operating thesis would be invalidated by sustained weakness in Weixin engagement or major games, deterioration in advertising monetization, material regulatory impairment, persistent AI spending without corresponding revenue or cash returns, or erosion of the net-cash position. limitations: The principal limitation is instrument-level: Tencent's release reports RMB results and EPS for Hong Kong-listed ordinary shares but does not establish TCEHY's unsponsored ADR entitlement. method_rationale: A 12-month normalized non-GAAP diluted-EPS multiple is used because Intel has returned to positive adjusted earnings but reported GAAP earnings remain distorted by large non-operating items. Q2 non-GAAP EPS was USD 0.42 and Q3 guidance was USD 0.38, providing a current earnings anchor. Scenario EPS and multiples vary with product demand, manufacturing yields, margins, capital intensity and evidence of external-foundry economics; cash from the equity offering is not added separately because its financing benefit, dilution and reinvestment outcomes are incorporated in the scenarios.
bear_assumptions: USD 1.50 normalized forward diluted EPS multiplied by 16. Product growth slows from the Q2 pace, gross-margin recovery stalls near current levels, foundry investment remains heavy and the enlarged share count limits per-share earnings. Arithmetic: USD 1.50 times 16 equals USD 24 per share.
base_assumptions: USD 2.40 normalized forward diluted EPS multiplied by 20. Client and data-center demand remain constructive, yields and utilization improve gradually, and offering proceeds fund the manufacturing program, but external-foundry returns remain immature. Arithmetic: USD 2.40 times 20 equals USD 48 per share.
bull_assumptions: USD 4.00 normalized forward diluted EPS multiplied by 25. AI-related compute demand persists, Intel 18A product execution translates into share and margin gains, and credible external-foundry or advanced-packaging demand produces operating leverage after dilution. Arithmetic: USD 4.00 times 25 equals USD 100 per share.
thesis: Intel has demonstrated a meaningful operating recovery: Q2 revenue increased 25% year over year, GAAP gross margin reached 40.4%, non-GAAP EPS was USD 0.42 and operating cash flow was USD 7.0 billion. Manufacturing evidence also indicates that High-NA EUV is being used in volume production for selected Intel 18A layers. However, most foundry revenue remains economically unproven as an external business, capital requirements are substantial, and the August common-stock offering increased the share count. The probability-weighted scenario value is USD 55.00, materially below the supplied October 23 market close of USD 86.95999908447266.
key_assumptions: The assessment assumes Q2 demand and yield improvements are real but moderates them because Q3 results had not yet been published as of the assessment date. It assumes normalized forward diluted EPS of USD 1.50, USD 2.40 and USD 4.00 in bear, base and bull cases; multiples of 16, 20 and 25 reflect respectively constrained economics, partial execution and strong execution. The 25%/50%/25% probabilities emphasize the base case while preserving substantial execution uncertainty. Probability-weighted value is USD 55.00: 25% of USD 24 plus 50% of USD 48 plus 25% of USD 100.
downside: The principal downside is that strong Q2 growth proves temporary while product competition, weak utilization or process delays prevent durable margin recovery. Foundry spending could continue consuming capital without sufficient third-party customer revenue, and the equity offering dilutes each existing share even though it improves financing resilience. Export controls, trade restrictions, component shortages, customer concentration and rapid semiconductor technology changes add operating risk. In the bear case, USD 24 represents approximately 72% downside from the supplied USD 86.95999908447266 reference price.
catalysts: Potential catalysts include Q3 results above the USD 15.8-16.8 billion revenue outlook, sustained DCAI growth, continued gross-margin expansion, further yield and cycle-time improvements, successful Intel 18A product ramps, externally attributable foundry or advanced-packaging commitments, and evidence that capital spending is converting into durable free cash flow. Intel is scheduled to report Q3 results on 2026-10-29, making that release the nearest fundamental evidence point.
invalidation_conditions: The recovery thesis would be weakened or invalidated by renewed product-share losses, Q3 results materially below guidance, deterioration in gross margin or cash generation, delayed Intel 18A or successor-node execution, lack of economically meaningful external-foundry demand, additional large dilution without commensurate per-share returns, or capital requirements that overwhelm operating cash generation. Conversely, the cautious valuation would require revision if sustained earnings approach or exceed the bull-case path and third-party foundry economics become demonstrably profitable.
limitations: Q3 2026 results were not available at the assessment time and are scheduled for 2026-10-29, so the valuation relies on Q2 results, Q3 guidance and subsequent manufacturing and financing disclosures. The accessible issuer releases do not provide a complete post-offering balance sheet, a quantified external-foundry backlog, customer-level foundry economics or enough evidence to distinguish internal manufacturing progress from profitable third-party demand. Scenario EPS values and multiples are therefore explicit judgmental assumptions rather than management forecasts. The supplied market observation is current and identity-matched, but it provides an end-of-session price rather than issuer financial evidence.

method_rationale: Risk-adjusted NPV is the appropriate framework for this clinical-stage biotechnology issuer because shareholder value depends on program-specific development probabilities, timing, costs, commercial cash flows, partnership economics, net cash consumption, and dilution. The October update provides preliminary clinical observations, selected collaboration terms, approximate cash, and the size of a new equity offering, but it does not provide enough evidence to bound pivotal-trial requirements, technical and regulatory probabilities, remaining program costs, pricing, penetration, launch timing, terminal economics, or fully diluted shares at commercialization. Consequently, no bear, base, or bull per-share value is supportable. Neither the USD 3.25 offering price nor cash on hand is used as fair value.
bear_assumptions: A bear scenario would require quantified probabilities and costs for clinical failure, regulatory delay, program discontinuation, accelerated cash use, and further dilution. Current evidence establishes that these risks exist but does not bound their magnitude well enough to assign a fair value or probability.
base_assumptions: A base scenario would require evidence-based estimates for REC-4881's registrational path, REC-1245 expansion results, development timelines and costs, addressable treated populations, pricing, penetration, partnership receipts, operating burn, and future share count. Those inputs remain unavailable or are only issuer estimates, so no value or probability is assigned.
bull_assumptions: A bull scenario would require validated efficacy in larger controlled or registrational studies, acceptable chronic safety, successful regulatory execution, repeatable partner milestones, and commercial assumptions that translate those outcomes into per-share cash flows. Preliminary single-arm and dose-escalation observations cannot support those inputs or a scenario probability.
thesis: Recursion has produced meaningful platform-to-clinic and partnership signals: REC-4881 showed broad and persistent polyp-burden reductions in a small Phase 1b/2 FAP dataset, REC-1245 showed initial responses at or above the selected expansion dose, and Sanofi optioned a development candidate. These developments strengthen evidence that the platform can generate programs, but they do not establish pivotal efficacy, approval, commercial value, or positive common-share economics after continuing research expense and dilution.
key_assumptions: Known facts are that the October clinical observations were preliminary, REC-4881's registrational-trial initiation is targeted for the second half of 2027 subject to FDA discussions, REC-1245 remains in early clinical development, Sanofi controls and funds further development of its optioned candidate, and the new offering comprises 61.54 million Class A shares at USD 3.25. Unknown assumptions required for valuation include program-specific success probabilities, final trial designs, enrollment and readout timing, remaining development and commercialization costs, net pricing, eligible patient populations, penetration, duration of therapy, partner milestone timing, future financing, cash burn, and fully diluted shares at commercialization.
downside: Interim results from small, open-label or single-arm populations may not persist in larger studies or translate into an approvable clinical benefit. REC-4881 had treatment-related adverse events and four discontinuations due to adverse events, while its registrational path remains subject to FDA discussions. REC-1245 response evidence is based on very few patients. Development failure, delay, weak partner economics, higher spending, or additional financing could consume the reported liquidity and dilute existing shareholders. The October issuance alone adds 61.54 million shares before considering other equity instruments or later funding.
catalysts: Potential evidence-changing events include detailed FDA-path guidance for REC-4881, presentation and maturation of its Phase 1b/2 dataset, initiation and design disclosure for a registrational study, additional REC-1245 monotherapy and expansion-cohort data, initiation of Sanofi's optioned candidate in Phase 1, further collaboration milestones, and audited quarterly financial results clarifying cash use and the post-offering share count. These are research catalysts, not valuation outputs.
invalidation_conditions: The constructive platform thesis would weaken if REC-4881's effect is not reproduced in a larger or regulator-acceptable study, chronic safety prevents sustained dosing, FDA discussions materially delay or expand the required program, REC-1245 responses fail to reproduce in expansion cohorts, partner programs stall or are returned, collaboration receipts remain immaterial relative to spending, or financing and equity compensation expand the share count faster than program value. Valuation support remains invalid until primary evidence can bound the missing clinical, commercial, cost, timing, and dilution inputs.
limitations: The October update is issuer-authored and reports preliminary, unaudited cash and early clinical datasets with small patient counts; no independent controlled efficacy comparison or completed registrational plan is available. The accessible offering release verifies price and share count but not a completed post-offering balance sheet or fully diluted capitalization. An attempted SEC filing retrieval was inaccessible and is not cited. Market price and offering price are financing observations, not fair-value estimates. Because the evidence cannot support ordered per-share scenarios with probabilities totaling 100, the assessment remains valuation_unsupported and all scenario values and probabilities are blank.

method_rationale: A forward earnings multiple is appropriate for ASML because it is profitable, its lithography systems and installed-base services produce observable earnings, and the principal valuation uncertainty is the durability of AI-related demand, premium margins and the multiple investors will pay through a semiconductor cycle. Per-share arithmetic converts EUR values to the instrument's USD currency using the ECB reference rate of 1 EUR = 1.1253 USD: bear EUR 40 EPS x 28 = EUR 1,120, or USD 1,260.34; base EUR 47 x 35 = EUR 1,645, or USD 1,851.12; bull EUR 54 x 42 = EUR 2,268, or USD 2,552.18. The EPS and multiples are explicit forward assumptions rather than issuer guidance.
bear_assumptions: Forward EPS of EUR 40 and a 28x multiple. Customer orders convert more slowly, export restrictions constrain shipments or service, capacity additions create cost pressure, and gross margin normalizes materially below the exceptional Q3 level. The 25% probability reflects meaningful policy, concentration, cycle and valuation risks despite current strong demand.
base_assumptions: Forward EPS of EUR 47 and a 35x multiple. The EUR 44-45 billion 2026 sales outlook converts substantially, installed-base demand remains resilient, AI-related Logic and Memory investment supports system demand, and margins remain structurally premium while easing from unusually strong quarterly levels. The 50% probability recognizes that management's current outlook supports this path but does not eliminate order-conversion and execution uncertainty.
bull_assumptions: Forward EPS of EUR 54 and a 42x multiple. AI-related investment remains durable, customer interest for 2029-2030 becomes firm orders, ASML expands capacity without significant margin dilution, productivity upgrades stay strong and leading-edge lithography intensity rises. The 25% probability reflects the substantial execution and duration assumptions required to sustain both exceptional earnings and a premium multiple.
thesis: ASML's scarce lithography capability, growing installed base and exposure to leading-edge Logic and Memory investment support durable premium economics. The Q3 issuer release reported EUR 11.662 billion of sales, a 57.5% gross margin, EUR 4.960 billion of net income, EUR 3.289 billion of installed-base sales and stronger long-dated customer interest. Those facts improve the earnings outlook, but the supplied USD 1,641.52 market price already discounts substantial success and remains exposed to export policy, customer concentration, order timing and multiple compression.
key_assumptions: The scenarios assume the Nasdaq ASML instrument retains one-for-one economic exposure to the issuer's ordinary-share earnings; the ECB rate of 1.1253 USD per EUR is held constant solely for valuation translation; normalized forward EPS ranges from EUR 40 to EUR 54; and justified multiples range from 28x to 42x according to demand durability and margin quality. They also assume the issuer substantially delivers its EUR 44-45 billion 2026 sales outlook, converts customer demand into recognized revenue, maintains access to critical suppliers and can fund planned capacity. None of the forward EPS figures or valuation multiples is company guidance.
downside: The bear value is USD 1,260.34, materially below the supplied USD 1,641.52 close. Downside can arise if nonbinding long-dated customer interest fails to become orders, existing orders are delayed or cancelled, export controls restrict systems or service, customer capital spending slows, High-NA adoption slips, supply-chain or capacity expansion costs erode margin, working capital absorbs cash, or the premium earnings multiple contracts. Q3's 57.5% gross margin may not represent a sustainable run rate.
catalysts: Potential catalysts include delivery near the upper end of 2026 sales guidance, Q4 gross margin around the guided 57%, continued growth in installed-base productivity upgrades, conversion of AI-related demand forecasts into binding orders and revenue, successful expansion of 2027-2028 EUV and DUV immersion capacity, broader High-NA adoption, and continued dividends or repurchases supported by cash generation.
invalidation_conditions: The positive thesis would be invalidated by a sustained decline in bookings or backlog conversion, material customer forecast reductions, export restrictions that impair shipments or installed-base service beyond the modeled bear case, structural gross-margin deterioration, repeated roadmap or capacity delays, loss of lithography intensity at leading-edge nodes, or evidence that reported earnings are not converting into durable cash generation. The base valuation should also be rejected if normalized forward EPS no longer plausibly reaches EUR 47 or a 35x multiple cannot be justified by growth and returns.
limitations: The issuer-authored distributed release provides current Q3 results and outlook but not enough detail to verify diluted weighted-average shares, full cash-flow movements, debt, backlog composition, customer concentration or geographic exposure. The issuer quarterly-results page and supplied SEC documents were not readable through the available broker in this operation, so the valuation does not claim a complete line-by-line filing review. Basic EPS, management demand statements and forward guidance are used as evidence; scenario EPS, multiples, probabilities and a constant FX rate are analyst assumptions. The New York registered-share security ID, issuer ID, Nasdaq MIC, ASML symbol and USD denomination are preserved; the release confirms Nasdaq trading under ASML but does not independently restate the supplied share-class descriptor.
